+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '80'
+title: Move the Router pin to the pushed work-queue Router and make the library and unit tests build
+---
+## What
+FoundationModelsRouter replaced turns with a per-session message queue and one generation queue for each model (Router commits 7e82607..9df76c4, design `../FoundationModelsRouter/generation-queue.md` §5.6 and §5.10, Router card ^d7d777f). Our `Package.resolved` pins Router at `7e8260785e8e3c9a11280684d36441e69e865931`.
+
+**Precondition (blocks this task):** the Router session pushes its local `main` (43 commits ahead of `origin/main` on 2026-09-26) to `origin`. Do not change `Package.swift` to a path dependency.
+
+Then run `swift package update FoundationModelsRouter` and change these API uses:
+
+- `Sources/FoundationModelsMultitool/MultiTool+TurnBoundary.swift`: rename the file to `MultiTool+SubmissionBoundary.swift`. Change `extension MultiTool: TurnBoundaryTool` / `turnWillBegin()` to `SubmissionBoundaryTool` / `submissionWillBegin()`, and update the header comment and the doc comment of `stage(_:)`. Note in the doc comment that the Router now calls the hook before each submission, and a continuation of the same answer is a submission too. Update the comment in `Capabilities/MCP/SurfaceRefresher.swift:10`.
+- `Sources/FoundationModelsMultitool/WaitTool.swift:126` and `Discovery/SearchToolsTool.swift:615`: `.synchronousUnbounded` becomes `.synchronous`. With no timeout set, `.synchronous` now has no deadline.
+- `WaitTool.swift:291`: `ToolContext.deadlineSecondsCeiling` is removed. An unbounded wait now passes `seconds: nil` to `ToolContext.wait(completionToken:seconds:)`.
+- `MultiToolConfiguration.swift:112`: `ToolMount.defaultTimeoutSeconds` is removed. Add a Multitool constant with the same value (120 s), for example `MultiToolConfiguration.defaultExecutionTimeLimit`, and use it.
+- `Sources/MultitoolCLI/CLIRunner.swift:1033-1035`: replace `.turnStarted` / `.turnEnded` in the `SessionEvent` switch with the new cases: `submissionQueued`, `submissionStarted`, `submissionEnded`, `answered`, `answerFailed`, `repetitionStopped`, `generationCall`. Also update the `ProfileDefinition.defaultContext` comment at `CLIRunner.swift:456-458`, because that constant is removed.
+- Unit tests: in `RegistrySwapTests.swift` and `SurfaceRefresherTests.swift`, replace `turnWillBegin()` with `submissionWillBegin()`. In `RunBindingTests.swift:30` and `HardeningTests.swift:23`, use the new Multitool constant. In `SuspendedContextTests.swift:56`, replace `.synchronousUnbounded` with `.synchronous`. In `SearchToolsToolTests.swift:341` and `WaitToolTests.swift:276`, update the comments. For the `terminalDetailTailLimit` uses in `SandboxGlobalsTests.swift:332-341` and `RouterSessionMountTests.swift:122`, temporarily assert against a local literal and link the follow-up task about the detail cap.
+- Fix each other compile error that `swift build --build-tests` reports against the new Router. Examples: `SessionEvent` switches in `Tests/Support/ScenarioGrading`, and `TranscriptEvent.Kind` switches (new `.generationCall` and `.repeatedPartRemoval`).
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] `Package.resolved` pins FoundationModelsRouter at a revision of `origin/main` that contains 9df76c4.
+- [ ] No source in `Sources/` or `Tests/` names `TurnBoundaryTool`, `turnWillBegin`, `synchronousUnbounded`, `deadlineSecondsCeiling`, `defaultTimeoutSeconds`, `turnStarted` or `turnEnded`. Check with `rg -w`.
+- [ ] `swift build --build-tests` passes with no errors and no new warnings.
+- [ ] `swift test` passes.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsMultitoolTests/RegistrySwapTests.swift`: the staged registry is applied by `submissionWillBegin()`.
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsMultitoolTests/WaitToolTests.swift`: add a test that an unbounded wait calls `ToolContext.wait` with `seconds: nil`.
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsMultitoolTests/HardeningTests.swift`: the default `executionTimeLimit` is 120 s.
+- [ ] Run `swift build --build-tests && swift test`. Expected result: all tests pass.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd`. Write failing tests first, then do the implementation that makes them pass.
\ No newline at end of file
